1
Qaid Muk Gayi Aye Sakina Mar Gayi Aye Sajjad Wain Paway.
Zindan Choon Ro Ro Ke Phophiyaan Toon Riya Puchda Kithe Bhain Nu Dafnaway.
Khandi Rayi Tamache Abid De Samne Aine Zulam Ne Wekhay Har Ik Bazar De.
Mar Ke V Sakina Da Darya Hoya Aye Lasha Kitay Shimar Aa Na Jaway.

2
Khamosh Dewaraan Te Zindaan Da Hanera Ik Dosre Nu Labhday Ray Bhain Te Bhira.
Oh Veer Da Na Lay Ke Onno Kol Bulandi Rayi Aye Bhain Nu Bulaway.
Aj So Gayi Aye Babay Nu Wajaan Mardi Sajjad Jagaonda Aye Nayi Bhain Jagdi.
Jay Moor Deway Zalim Aye Bhain Jagawan Layi Babay Da Sir Wakhaway.

3
Waqt-e-Rehai Qaidi Zindan Chon Nikle Sab Pursa Sakina Da Bemar Nu Denday Ray.
Ro Ro Ke Sakina Di Turbat Nu Koi Chumda Aye Koi Seene Naal Laway.
Paband-e-Salasal Way Masoma Da Bhira Sabir Kiwein Uthaye Oh Bhain Da Lasha.
Ohh Sochda Aye Kidhre Aidi Bhain De Lashay Nu Zanjeer Na Chubh Jaway.

from pathlib import Path

p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/qaid-muk-gayi-aye-sakina-mar-gayi-aye-sajjad-wain-paway-lyrics-punjabi-tajpoints-d9dfffd50b86c651922e.md\")

meta, body = p.read_text().split(\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
roman = meta.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)[1]
assert [line.strip().casefold() for line in roman.splitlines()] == [line.rstrip(\".\").casefold() for line in old.splitlines()]
for i, (source, reading) in enumerate(zip(body.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\"), old.split(\"\\n\\n\"), strict=True), 1):
    assert source.splitlines()[0] == \"۱۲۳\"[i-1]
    assert len(source.splitlines()) == len(reading.splitlines()) == 5
assert \"\\u200c\" not in body
print(\"Verified all 12 Roman verses and three corresponding Shahmukhi stanzas.\")

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 Punjabi verses in Shahmukhi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have three corresponding four-verse stanzas.

Updated the script metadata to `pa-Arab` and `rtl`, removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag, and dropped “Lyrics Punjabi 2017” from the title. I read the ambiguous `darya` as `ڈریا` (“afraid”). Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
